# skyphusion.org

> Skyphusion Labs: free AGPL open source tools you own. Not for sale.

## Products
- Vivijure (self-hosted AI film studio, v1.0): https://vivijure.com
- Vivijure demo: https://demo.vivijure.com
- Postern (mailbox for humans and agents, v1.4): https://github.com/skyphusion-labs/postern
- Postern demo: https://demo.posternonline.com
- Prism (multimodal AI, public BYOK): https://play.skyphusion.org
- The Hollow Grid: https://hollow.skyphusion.org
- security-audit: https://github.com/skyphusion-labs/security-audit
- search-mcp: https://github.com/skyphusion-labs/search-mcp
